card.text: Explore Nereid, a moon of Neptune, through its source-backed size model.

introduction.text: Nereid follows a highly elongated orbit around Neptune. This approximate ellipsoid comes from light-curve and thermal modelling; its shape and pole are not unique. The grid marks unmapped terrain.

model.title: Light-curve shape approximation
model.summary: Approximate ellipsoid from light-curve and thermal modelling (long/short ≈ 1.3), scaled to a 170 km mean radius. Shape and pole are not unique. The grid marks unmapped terrain.
